name: [Update🚗] Horizon Brazil
desc:
🚗 Horizon Brazil🇧🇷
Welcome to Horizon Brazil, Roblox's most electrifying open world! 🌆
Explore Brazil-inspired cities, race on amazing roads, and experience the thrill on four wheels! 🏁

Here, you can customize your car your way - choose the color, the wheels, modify your engine and show off your style on the streets! 😎
Participate in races with your friends, discover new places and feel the freedom to drive through a map full of life and adventures. 🌴☀️

💬 Join the community, speed up with the jail and show who's in charge of the asphalt!
In Horizon Brazil, every corner is a new story - and the steering wheel is in your hands!

👉 Enter now and live this unique experience! 🇧🇷🔥
